newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Swiss Exchange adds Ciba to index.
newsitem.headline: Swiss Exchange adds Ciba to index.

text.p: The Swiss Exchange said it is de-listing the subscription rights to Ciba Specialty Chemicals Holding Inc and incorporating the speciality chemical group's shares into the Swiss Index and Swiss Market Index.
The move reflects the start of trading on Thursday in Ciba SC's shares. Ciba SC was spun off from Novartis AG.

The speciality chemical group's shares are being incorporated in the SMI on a one-for-one basis at the closing price of the delisted rights plus nominal value of 10 francs. -- Zurich Editorial +41 1 631 7340
